notes.title: Cat Quest III Turns 1 and More Exciting News!
notes.content:
[p]Cat Quest III turns 1 TODAY 🎉 😻 [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t believe it’s already been a year since Cat Quest III launched. Thank you to all our players sailing the Purribean with us and for all your surpawt, we couldn't have done it without you 💕

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155993/101c077be9e9f9cbd44b45fe056c4e560e7e90ad.png"][/img][/p][p]Since launch, we've continued to add more content, including mew quests, characters (looking at you Macho Dog), crewmates and treasure galore![/p][p]
If you’ve been busy pouncing around the Purribean and haven’t caught up with the news, you can find more information below.
[/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/4441207839043616818"][u][b]Mew Content[/b][/u][/url][/h3][p]☠️ Five New Side Quests[/p][p]🏴‍☠️ Four New Dungeons[/p][p]🐾 Three New Boss Fights[/p][p]💎 New Gear Galore[/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/500564506841187169"][u][b]Mew Game Mode[/b][/u][/url][/h3][p]Mew Game Mode allows the player to add a variety of unique meowdifiers to their game for a more challenging experience, including ‘Ruffer Enemies’, where different and more powerful enemies appear; ‘Fast Furwards’, where everything moves at twice the speed - even you; ‘No Levelling’ and many more![/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/537730617501024362"][u][b]Tavern Tales Update[/b][/u][/url][/h3][p]⚔️ 5 Tavern Tale boss fights, including a secret one that only unlocks after completing all the tales.[/p][p]🦜 5 unlockable Crew Mates[/p][p]🏴‍☠️ More Wanted posters for completing new bosses that were added in previous updates.[/p][p]🎁 A new trinket is given by Mama Milka for defeating the Dragon Boar.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cat Quest III Arrives on Apple Devices![/b][/h2][p]
Cat Quest III is now available on the [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cat-quest-iii/id1551304183"][u]App Store[/u][/url] for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, featuring all the content updates that have been released. Play with touchscreen controls with your iPaws or team up in co-op by connecting two supported controllers and explore the Purribean together![/p][p]
[/p][p]The game is free to try, and you can unlock the full game via an in-game purchase.[/p][p]
Available meow on the App Store with up to [b]50% off[/b] for a limited time.


[/p][h2][b]Pawsome Steam Sales[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]To celebrate all of this, our catventure Cat Quest III is [b]50%[/b] off until [b]August 21st[/b]![/p][p]
If you're new to our catventures, why not check out our previous titles: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/593280/Cat_Quest/"][u]Cat Quest[/u][/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/Cat_Quest_II/"][u]Cat Quest II[/u][/url] and an array of meowverlous bundles are up to [b]80% off[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cat Quest III | Tavern Tales Update Out MEOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, fur-midable adventurers! 🐾

The meow-velous free update, Tavern Tales, has arrived in Cat Quest III!

[previewyoutube=LgxO2Jwcir8;full][/previewyoutube]
Hoist the sails and head to the Tavern, tap on the mic and purr-pare for Cappey to retell the tales of how you defeated the Pirate Lords. Cappey may have taken some creative liberties and added some exaggerations, but isn’t this how the best tales are told?

Upon completing each tale, you will unlock a companion to join your crew! Your new crew mates are various species of parrots with their own abilities and traits that join and fight beside you on your adventures! Now you can be a bonafide pirate with yer very own parrot, yarr~!


[h2]New Content:[/h2]
⚔️ 5 Tavern Tale boss fights, including a secret one that only unlocks after completing all the tales.
🦜 5 unlockable Crew Mates
🏴‍☠️ More Wanted posters for completing new bosses that were added in previous updates.
🎁 A new trinket is given by Mama Milka for defeating the Dragon Boar.


[h2]Steam Summer Sale[/h2]
It’s that time of the year when the sun is shining and you’re looking to stay cool, and what better way than to sail the high seas in Cat Quest III, which is now [b]40% off![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/ 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the new Tavern Tales mode! Fight remixed versions of the Pirate Lords and win the loyalty of new crew mates!
[*] Added a 'Fast Furwards' toggle in the Options. (Only unlocked after completing 'Fast Furwards' in Mew Game)
[*] Added 'Large Text' mode in the Options.
[*] Added a new Trinket; Mama Milka's Special!
[*] Added new Wanted Posters to claim rewards from!
[*] Tweaked the Defense stat to be more balanced at high and low levels.
[*] Tweaked the Equipment scaling to be higher in New Game + and beyond.
[*] New Game+ now raises the enemy level by 100 instead of 80.
[*] Minor Balance tweaks to certain bosses.
[*] Minor adjustment to sound effects for certain weapons.
[*] Fixed minor localization errors.
[*] Created a fallback for an error that occurs when the user's files are not readable due to a lack of permissions.
[/list]

notes.title: Cat Quest III | Mew Game Mode Out MEOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, meow hearties! 🐾

Hoist the sails and get ready to embark on a more challenging catventure with Mew Game Mode!

[previewyoutube=s3Bd4RQCP1o;full][/previewyoutube]
Listen up ye purrywags! Mew Game Mode allows the player to add a variety of unique meowdifiers to their game for a more challenging experience.

Conquer the seas of the Purribean in Mew Game Mode and earn some treasure for completing it. The more meowdifiers selected, the greater the reward! 🐾⚓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155993/5ece7c42066121a155111b4b68e3262f6117dd4b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meowdifiers[/h2]

🐱 Nine Lives - You can only 'Game Over' nine times. After which, the game kicks players back to the main menu and deletes the save file.

🏴‍☠️ Ruffer Enemies - Different and more powerful enemies appear.

🐾 Naked Paws - Armor and weapons cannot be equipped. Trinkets still can be equipped.

🔮 Purre Magic - You can only cast spells. Mana regenerates automatically and quickly.

🚫 No Leveling - You cannot level up.

⏩ Fast Furwards - Everything moves at twice the speed. Even you.

⚔️ No Upgrades - You cannot upgrade anything, not even spells.

🚢 Furriendly Ship - Your ship does one damage.


[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shield dodge animation has been tweaked to look more unique.
[*] Slightly reduced the damage of Mewteor and Ice Paw.
[*] Bug fix: certain items were given at too high a level.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/

notes.title: Happy Mew Year! What does 2025 hold for Cat Quest III?
notes.content:
Greetings Fellow Catventurers! Happy Mew Year, wherever you are in the world! 

We hope ye purrywags be enjoyin' yer stay in the Purribean!

It has been a pawsome past few months for the Cat Quest series! With everyone's surpawt, Cat Quest III is the fastest selling Cat Quest game ever! Thank you all so much for this!

We still have much more planned for Cat Quest III in the near future too, so be ready for it! Early 2025 will see the release of the much awaited Mew Game mode where players can play the game with unique meowdifiers for a more challenging experience! 

Furthermore, a few months after that will see the release of another content update... but more news on this in the future. 😺

For many of us in the team, working on the Cat Quest games and interacting with you guys have truly felt like a privilege. It is quite unbelievable to see how far we've come with the series and we only aim to make even better in future instalments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44155993/a8315fb9402a1ba2043666d236178422c28e59f2.jpg[/img]

So from all of us in the Gentlebros team, we wish everyone a Happy Mew Year! Thank you for your Support!

~ The Gentlebros

notes.title: Nominate Cat Quest III in the Steam Awards!

Hey fur-midable adventurers!  

We’re over the meow-n to announce that Cat Quest III is eligible for the 2024 Steam Awards, and we need YOUR support to pounce on some amazing nominations! Our pawsome community has always been the heart of this journey, so we’re asking for your help.

We think we are the cat’s whiskers for the Best Game on Steam Deck award! Getting steam deck verified was an early must-have for us and we've been thrilled to see so many of you with the Purribean in the palm of your hands.

notes.title: All A-pawd! Cat Quest III has landed ashore!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JoIGmxVr0P8;full][/previewyoutube]

Set sail in this 2.5D open-world action RPG and brace yourself for a meow-nificent journey filled with furry fun and adventure. Play alone, or locally with a friend, and defeat those troublesome Pi-Rats. 

Dive into a paw-geous new world with varied dungeons, biomes, and furr-ociously fun gameplay! Engage in fierce battles with a refined combat system featuring tighter attack combos and weapon swapping, and more customisation than ever before! Purrrrrfection.

[h2]Dress Fur Battle![/h2]

Discover trinkets from around the world to transform your character into a fur-midable Pi-rat beating Powerhouse! Experiment with dozens of gear sets, weapons, spells, and trinkets to purr-fect your ultimate build. You can even kit your ship out with some claw-some weapons!

For the fur-st time in the series, command your very own ship! Explore the seas, seamlessly zip to shore, and traverse the land on paw to hunt for booty. Discover treasures, furr-ocious spells, and gla-meow-rous costumes!

Uncover the secrets of the North Star. Cat Quest III is Out Now on Steam, and we are so excited fur you to get your paws on it. 

Paws Truly, 

The Gentlebros

notes.title: How to be a Pirate - New Trailer!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Purrivateers!
Are ye ready to embark on a legendary Catventure in Cat Quest III? Set your sights on the Purribean, a world bursting with beautiful islands and swarmin' with Pi-rats in search of the mythical North Star Treasure!

[previewyoutube=ivqrZCbwZUY;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn the best ways to be a pirate as you explore from top to bottom, but beware – some places are more perrilous than others. Interact with all the quirky characters and suspicious objects you can find; surprises lurk around every corner!
Don't sail solo! Bring a matey along for local co-op action and double the fun. Equip both short and long-range weapons, and master weapon swappin' for furri-ghteningly fast combos to dominate the seven seas!

No pirate is complete without a ship. Sail the refreshin' waters, zip ashore, and explore the land on paw in a flash! A bounty is on your head, so be ready to dodge and shoot at pi-rats trying to sink your ship. Stay swift and sharp!

Unravel the meow-steries of the North Star Treasure, brave prrivateer. The ultimate adventure awaits in Cat Quest III!

Purr-eorder Available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/]Meow[/url]

Wishlist Cat Quest III now for its release on August 8th!
